item.title: UK CMA Proposes Rules to Open Apple Pay to Rivals
item.description: The UK CMA is urging Apple to lower NFC fees and allow Host Card Emulation, letting rival payment apps run on iPhone while safeguarding security.

item.title: Why You Can Skip The $59 Brick With Free NFC Apps
